{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.42

|gr1= Revive

|descr= Should be called from Killed event handler. Handles what happens if unit dies if revive system is enabled.

|s1=

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>BIS_unit addEventHandler ["Killed",

}];</sqf>
